changes: Use GitHub codeload as the primary immutable-commit archive transport instead of the REST tarball endpoint that returned HTTP 429.
Keep authenticated GitHub REST as fallback with slower retries.
Cache the exact commit archive after the first successful fetch.
Record source archive SHA-256, pinned commit, and transport in the uploaded receipt.
Add a runtime verification step before any worker contact.
claim_boundary: This patch changes only pre-contact source transport. It does not change the SELF-001 preregistration, evaluator, scope mapping, thresholds, prompts, candidate selection, or protected-regression checks.
